Definition: Achijah, the name of nine Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Two men share this name, and both matter: Ahijah the Shilonite, the prophet who tore his garment and gave ten pieces to Jeroboam, and Ahiah son of Ahitub, the priest who wore the ephod with Saul's army.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold the prophet's torn garment as the greater of the two stories: God's word does not merely describe the future, it divides it. When Ahijah tore the cloth, the kingdom was already torn.
